summary: Phase 4 meets the original task and plan.md. Per-user isolation holds on the activity page (no id parameter; causer = user, or subject = user with a null causer), on receipts (scoped lookup gives 404 on download/update/remove for other users), on exports (scoped query, same permission and plan gating) and on cache keys (finestro:user:{id}:v{version}:..., bypassed without auth). Activity rows use per-model allowlists and contain no secrets, tokens, keys, Stripe ids, balances or documents. The two migrations only create the activity_log and media tables, and receipt_path is kept. The CSV keeps the 10 pt-BR headers, ';' and the UTF-8 BOM, and XLSX was added. Both mailables and both Breeze notifications are queued with tries/backoff. All four Part B items are fixed, and docs/infrastructure/phase-4-packages.md is complete. Recorded evidence: composer quality exit 0, 397 tests / 1355 assertions on both the normal and the random-order run, PHPStan baseline still 3 entries, migrate --pretend additive. The remaining findings are non-blocking hardening items.
findings: Non-blocking (likely): StripeGateway::isResourceMissing() treats any resource_missing/404 as 'already canceled'. Stripe returns the same error when the key is in a different mode or account, so a misconfigured key would let a paying user's account be deleted while the real subscription keeps billing. Log this branch at error level and treat 'similar object exists in live/test mode' messages as a real failure.

Non-blocking (confirmed, low impact): ReceiptService remove()/attach() delete and write files inside DB::transaction() in TransactionService. A later failure rolls back the media rows but not the files, leaving orphan files or a media row whose file was deleted (download then 404s). Consider deferring remove() with DB::afterCommit() or cleaning up on failure.

Non-blocking (confirmed): the 'Atividade da conta' page shows raw UUIDs for wallet_id/category_id changes under the 'Carteira'/'Categoria' labels. Resolve the names in AccountActivityService or hide these fields.
Non-blocking (confirmed): the Free-plan redirect and missing-reports.export 403 tests cover only the default CSV format. Add a format=xlsx case to each.
